021import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
022
023import java.util.List;
024import java.util.Set;
025import java.util.TreeMap;
026import java.util.UUID;
027
028/**
029 * Provides an API for managing tags associated with shops and players.
030 *
031 * <p>The {@code TagManager} allows plugins and internal systems to:</p>
032 * <ul>
033 *   <li>Add, remove, or toggle tags on shops</li>
034 *   <li>Query tags associated with a shop or player</li>
035 *   <li>Filter shops based on tag criteria</li>
036 *   <li>Clear tags globally, per shop, or per player</li>
037 *   <li>Retrieve tag statistics and counts</li>
038 * </ul>
039 *
040 * <p>Tags are stored per player per shop, meaning each player maintains
041 * their own tagging view of shops. Tags may be used for systems such as
042 * favorites, watchlists, or custom player categorization.</p>
043 *
044 * <p>Implementations are expected to maintain an in-memory cache for
045 * fast lookup while delegating persistence operations to {@link TagService}.</p>
046 *
047 * @author creatorfromhell
048 * @since 6.3.0.0
049 */
050public interface TagManager {
051
052  /**
053   * Loads all tag-related data from the database into memory.
054   *
055   * This method initializes or refreshes the in-memory representation
056   * of tags and their associations by retrieving the complete tag data
057   * set from the underlying database. It should be called during
058   * application startup or when a full reload of tag data is needed.
059   */
060  void loadAllFromDB();
061
062  /**
063   * Adds a tag to a shop for a specific player.
064   *
065   * This method calls the underlying {@code addTag} implementation with default
066   * parameters, applying the tag and persisting it to the database.
067   *
068   * @param shopId the ID of the shop
069   * @param player the player applying the tag
070   * @param tag    the tag to apply
071   *
072   * @return the result of the tagging operation
073   */
074  default TaggingResult addTag(final long shopId, final UUID player, final String tag) {
075    return addTag(shopId, player, tag, true);
076  }
077
078  /**
079   * Adds a tag to a shop for a specific player.
080   *
081   * @param shopId the ID of the shop
082   * @param player the player applying the tag
083   * @param tag    the tag to apply
084   * @param db     whether to persist the tag to the database
085   *
086   * @return the result of the tagging operation
087   *
088   * @since 6.3.0.0
089   */
090  TaggingResult addTag(long shopId, UUID player, String tag, final boolean db);
091
092  /**
093   * Toggles a tag on a shop for a player.
094   *
095   * <p>If the tag already exists it will be removed,
096   * otherwise it will be added.</p>
097   *
098   * @param shopId the ID of the shop
099   * @param player the player toggling the tag
100   * @param tag    the tag to toggle
101   *
102   * @return the result of the operation
103   *
104   * @since 6.3.0.0
105   */
106  TaggingResult toggleTag(long shopId, UUID player, String tag);
107
108  /**
109   * Removes all tags from all shops for all players.
110   *
111   * @return true if the operation completed successfully
112   *
113   * @since 6.3.0.0
114   */
115  boolean removeAllTags();
116
117  /**
118   * Removes all tags associated with a specific shop.
119   *
120   * @param shopId the shop ID
121   *
122   * @return true if tags were removed
123   *
124   * @since 6.3.0.0
125   */
126  boolean removeAllShopTags(long shopId);
127
128  /**
129   * Removes all tags applied by a specific player to a shop.
130   *
131   * @param shopId the shop ID
132   * @param player the player whose tags should be removed
133   *
134   * @return true if tags were removed
135   *
136   * @since 6.3.0.0
137   */
138  boolean removeAllShopTagsBy(long shopId, UUID player);
139
140  /**
141   * Removes all tags applied by a player across every shop.
142   *
143   * @param player the player whose tags should be removed
144   *
145   * @return true if the operation completed
146   *
147   * @since 6.3.0.0
148   */
149  boolean removeAllPlayerTags(UUID player);
150
151  /**
152   * Gets the total number of tags currently stored.
153   *
154   * @return total tag count
155   *
156   * @since 6.3.0.0
157   */
158  int totalTags();
159
160  /**
161   * Gets the total number of tags applied by a specific player.
162   *
163   * @param player the player
164   *
165   * @return number of tags applied by the player
166   *
167   * @since 6.3.0.0
168   */
169  int totalTagsByPlayer(UUID player);
170
171  /**
172   * Returns a count of tags grouped by shop for a player.
173   *
174   * <p>The returned {@link TreeMap} maps shop IDs to the number of
175   * tags the player has applied to each shop.</p>
176   *
177   * @param player the player
178   *
179   * @return a map containing tag counts per shop
180   *
181   * @since 6.3.0.0
182   */
183  TreeMap<Long, Integer> tagsCount(UUID player);
184
185  /**
186   * Retrieves the tags applied by a player to a specific shop.
187   *
188   * @param player the player
189   * @param shopId the shop ID
190   *
191   * @return a set of tags applied by the player
192   *
193   * @since 6.3.0.0
194   */
195  Set<String> tagsFilteredByShop(UUID player, long shopId);
196
197  /**
198   * Retrieves all shop IDs that match a given tag for a player.
199   *
200   * @param player the player
201   * @param tag    the tag to filter by
202   *
203   * @return list of shop IDs containing the tag
204   *
205   * @since 6.3.0.0
206   */
207  List<Long> shopsFilteredByTag(UUID player, String tag);
208
209  /**
210   * Retrieves shop IDs matching all provided tags for a player.
211   *
212   * @param player     the player
213   * @param filterTags the tags used as filter criteria
214   *
215   * @return list of shop IDs matching the filter
216   *
217   * @since 6.3.0.0
218   */
219  List<Long> shopsFilteredByTags(UUID player, List<String> filterTags);
220
221  /**
222   * Sends a formatted list of shops matching a tag filter to a player.
223   *
224   * <p>This is typically used by commands such as favorites or watchlists.</p>
225   *
226   * @param player     the player to send the results to
227   * @param filterTags the tags to filter shops by
228   * @param type       the type of tag filter (e.g., "favorite", "watchlist")
229   * @param titleNode  the message node used for the list title
230   * @param noEntries  the message node used when no results exist
231   *
232   * @since 6.3.0.0
233   */
234  void listShopsByFilter(Player player, final String commandLabel, final int page, final List<String> filterTags, final String type, String titleNode, String noEntries);
235
236  /**
237   * Checks whether a player has applied a specific tag to a shop.
238   *
239   * @param shopId the shop ID
240   * @param player the player
241   * @param tag    the tag to check
242   *
243   * @return true if the tag exists
244   *
245   * @since 6.3.0.0
246   */
247  boolean hasTag(long shopId, UUID player, String tag);
248
249  /**
250   * Removes a specific tag from all shops for a player.
251   *
252   * @param player the player
253   * @param tag    the tag to remove
254   *
255   * @return true if the operation completed
256   *
257   * @since 6.3.0.0
258   */
259  boolean removeTag(UUID player, String tag);
260
261  /**
262   * Removes a specific tag from a single shop for a player.
263   *
264   * @param shopId the shop ID
265   * @param player the player
266   * @param tag    the tag to remove
267   *
268   * @return the result of the removal operation
269   *
270   * @since 6.3.0.0
271   */
272  TaggingResult removeTag(long shopId, UUID player, String tag);
273
274  /**
275   * Returns the underlying {@link TagService} responsible for persistence and normalization
276   * operations.
277   *
278   * @return the tag service
279   *
280   * @since 6.3.0.0
281   */
282  TagService service();
283}
